title: Pieces of Eight
subtitle: Farewell, Override. Ahoy, Treasure Hunters!
version_note: Written on 29 October 2026, three days before the Treasure Hunters mini-season (update 43.00) launches on 1 November. Everything about the new season comes from Epic's teasers and trailer, news reports and leaks, checked against several sources. Plenty will change at launch.
description: An unofficial Fortnite fan book: a farewell to Chapter 7 Season 4 (Override), a pirate primer for the Treasure Hunters mini-season and its One Piece crossover, and some real pirate history along the way.
glossary_blurb: Every Word Watch word in this book, from A to Z. A true treasure hunter hoards words as well as gold. Pick three and see if you can sneak them into conversation before the new season lands. Bonus doubloons for using one in the lobby.

chapters.title: Ahoy, Shipmates!
chapters.label: Start here
chapters.dek: One season is sinking over the horizon, and a pirate ship is sailing in. Here's how to read this book, and how to tell a real treasure map from a fake one.

chapters.title: So Long, Override
chapters.toc: A farewell party for the season that's ending
chapters.dek: Seventy-three days of Sprites, hacks, pumpkins, birthday cake and pure joy. Before the pirates arrive, let's throw Override the farewell party it deserves.

chapters.title: The Chest That Sang
chapters.dek: A giant chest that filled up like a loading bar, songs drifting across the water, and a pirate ship sailing out of the fog. How Epic revealed the new season.

chapters.title: X Marks the Drop
chapters.toc: The map, the places and the flying ship
chapters.dek: A brand-new island, a pirate ship instead of a Battle Bus, and places borrowed straight from One Piece. Our first look at where you'll be landing.

chapters.title: Pieces of Eight
chapters.toc: Real pirates, real treasure, and a Sydney coin with a hole in it
chapters.dek: Before Fortnite had pirates, the real world had thousands of them. Meet the most famous, find out what pirate treasure actually was, and learn which bits of pirate legend are pure make-believe.

chapters.title: Fly the Flag
chapters.dek: Real pirates flew terrifying flags so their victims would surrender without a fight. Treasure Hunters has six crews, each with its own Jolly Roger. Pick your side.

chapters.title: Meet the Straw Hats
chapters.toc: Who Luffy and his crew are, and why everyone's so excited
chapters.dek: Never watched One Piece? No problem. Here's the rubber-armed captain, his crew of misfits and the greatest treasure hunt in comics, explained in one chapter.

chapters.title: Most Wanted
chapters.toc: Fortnite's own pirates, the guest stars, and who's in the Battle Pass
chapters.dek: Jonesy in a pirate coat, Cuddle Team Leader with a sword, two singing superstars and a mysterious masked figure. Everyone else who's sailing in.

chapters.title: Loot Ahoy
chapters.toc: The new weapons, the Straw Hat Mythics and our Hype Meter
chapters.dek: Cannons are back. So is something that looks a lot like a blunderbuss. Plus a stretchy punch, three swords at once and a slingshot. We rate the hype.

chapters.title: Here Be Monsters
chapters.toc: Sea monsters, new Sprites and the mystery voice
chapters.dek: A sea serpent called the Lord of the Coast, a Sprite that lives in a treasure chest, and a whispering voice nobody can identify. The season's unsolved mysteries.

chapters.title: Land Ho!
chapters.toc: Launch day, Chapter 8, and how to be a leak detective
chapters.dek: When you can actually play it in Sydney, what's coming after it, and how to tell treasure from fool's gold when the leaks start flying.

chapters.title: Walk the Plank Quiz
chapters.label: Back of the book
chapters.dek: Fifteen questions. Every right answer earns you a piece of eight. Every wrong one moves you a step closer to the end of the plank.

chapters.title: The Treasure Chest of Words
chapters.toc: Every Word Watch word, A to Z
chapters.label: Back of the book
